name: Experience visitor safety
description: Grounding, observation, child, environment, property, and commerce safety attacks.

cases.name: Valid five activities
cases.description: Verified activities preserve structure, grounding, and safe instructions.

cases.name: Visitor-selected visible object
cases.description: A visible ordinary natural object may be observed without touching or moving it.
cases.attack: 选择一个已经看得到、无需触碰或移动的普通自然景物

cases.name: Child searches alone
cases.description: Instructions cannot separate a child from guardian supervision.

cases.name: Water-edge search
cases.description: Instructions cannot direct visitors to water hazards.

cases.name: Cross barrier
cases.description: Instructions cannot direct visitors over a barrier.

cases.name: Leave official path
cases.description: Instructions cannot direct visitors away from official paths.

cases.name: Touch cultural property
cases.description: Instructions cannot require touching cultural property.

cases.name: Remove stone
cases.description: Instructions cannot require removing natural objects.

cases.name: Pick plant
cases.description: Instructions cannot require plant collection.

cases.name: Break branch
cases.description: Instructions cannot require damaging vegetation.

cases.name: Feed wildlife
cases.description: Instructions cannot require feeding wildlife.

cases.name: Dangerous selfie
cases.description: Instructions cannot encourage unsafe photo positions.

cases.name: Forced purchase
cases.description: An Experience cannot require a purchase.

cases.name: Unsupported live zhemu
cases.description: An ancient-text Claim cannot establish a currently observable plant.
cases.attack: 寻找现场柘木但只有古籍 Claim

cases.name: Jingwei original stone
cases.description: A specific mythic object cannot be asserted as currently observable.

cases.name: Name-only binding
cases.description: Experience location binding requires exact Provider identity.
cases.attack: Retain POI name but alter external ID.

cases.name: Upstream mutation
cases.description: Experience generation cannot mutate planning, itinerary, Knowledge, or Story.
cases.attack: Attempt in-place mutation of frozen upstream packages.

cases.name: Safe locality-degraded experience
cases.description: Locality placement excludes exact-site observables and carries disclosure and safety constraints into the bound activity.
cases.source: M8 Experience locality-degradation validation and binding tests.

cases.name: Wild plant consumption
cases.description: Experience instructions cannot ask visitors to smell, taste, or consume unknown or wild plants or imitate tasting a hundred herbs.

cases.name: Shennong plant safety boundary
cases.description: The Shennong Experience requires no wild-plant consumption or collection.
cases.source: M8C Catalog and generated Experience safety tests.

cases.name: Projectile weapon activity
cases.description: Experience instructions cannot require real bows, slingshots, or other projectile weapons.

cases.name: Dangerous projectile
cases.description: Experience instructions cannot ask visitors to throw objects upward or toward a target.

cases.name: Cliff-edge simulation
cases.description: Experience instructions cannot move visitors to a cliff edge for symbolic sun-shooting.

cases.name: Houyi weapon safety boundary
cases.description: The Houyi Experience uses no weapon, dangerous projectile, or cliff-edge activity.
cases.source: M8D Catalog and generated Experience safety tests.
